scenes.audio: A single, high-pitched digital 'pop' sound effect, followed by silent, upbeat minimalist background music featuring a light electronic pulse.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A static wide shot of a stylized web browser window centered on a plain white background. The browser header is light gray with three small circles (purple, red, and yellow) in the top left corner. The main body of the window is dark charcoal gray. Bold, white Chinese characters meaning 'Recording' appear in the center of the dark window. The lighting is flat, digital, and shadowless with a clean, minimalist aesthetic.

scenes.audio: A second digital 'pop' sound effect, slightly lower in pitch than the first, synchronized with the appearance of the new characters. The minimalist electronic pulse continues at a steady tempo.
scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.visual: The browser window remains static. To the right of the existing 'Recording' text, a purple 'not equal to' symbol (≠) and a second set of white Chinese characters meaning 'Memory' appear suddenly. The arrangement is centered horizontally within the dark browser interface. The color palette remains dark gray, white, and purple with sharp, high-contrast edges.
